newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Queensland barley harvest nears.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Queensland barley harvest nears.

text.p: With the start to southern Queensland's barley harvest just several weeks a way, the ritual of cat-and-mouse between buyers and growers is getting into full swing, grains traders said on Monday.

But expectations of a bumper crop of nearly 400,000 tonnes of feed barley, compared with only 160,000 tonnes last year, is encouraging buyers to hold off as long as possible before committing to purchases, they said.
Grainco expects southern Queensland's feed barley harvest to total nearly 400,000 tonnes.
The overall wheat harvest should climb to around 1.8 million tonnes, up from 650,000 tonnes last year, Brealey added.

Time will tell whether they are correct or whether values will remain steady at current levels of around A$143.00 a tonne delivered Brisbane through to early next year, Grainco Ltd trading manager Rob Brealey said.
Growers also are showing a reluctance to sell in the hopes of a boost from a stronger international market.

"But at some point, growers will be under pressure to sell," Brealey said. Brealey said improved growing conditions over last year, when crops were hurt by a severe drought, have boosted expectations for this year's harvest.
